verdict.rationale: Plan-limit behavior is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform with an API and automation rules, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents API rate limits, automation-run quotas, or what happens on overage (charges, throttling such as 429 responses, or a hard stop). The agent 'cost constraints' and 'spend' governance in asana-docs-13 is an adjacent control, not a disclosure of plan-limit overage behavior, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
